description: The ETM System is a PBX/soft switch-independent, easy-to-use platform that supports security and management applications for real-time visibility, security, and control of telecommunications resources across the enterprise. The ETM System's C Language Applications Dynamic Link Library provides Triple DES encryption routines for Windows-based ETM Applications, such as the ETM Collection Server. The C Language DLL is used to secure network communications between the ETM Collection Server and ETM Call Recorder Cache Appliances.
